The lead investigator exposes all concealed mini-cards. Flip Tzu San Niang to her (Out for Blood) side and heal all damage from her. She engages the lead investigator. Advance the agenda directly to agenda 3a (do not resolve agenda 2b).

vi_current.name: Ánh Sáng Ma Trơi
vi_current.text: Objective — Thu thập di vật và chuẩn bị lễ cầu siêu xoa dịu oán linh.
vi_current.flavor: Chiếc lược ngọc và lá thư tình đẫm máu là những manh mối then chốt.
vi_current.back_flavor: Linh hồn người phụ nữ hiện thân đầy vẻ phẫn nộ đòi lại công lý!

en.name: Harvester of Woe
en.text: [reaction] When you are dealt damage and/or horror from Tzu San Niang's forced effect, investigators at your location may spend any number of clues: Cancel that much damage/horror. Objective - If Tzu San Niang is defeated, advance.
en.flavor: The Lady with the Red Parasol has shifted her attention to you. She sings a haunting song as she stalks through the streets. Under any other circumstance, you might find the melody beautiful.
en.back_text: The investigators must decide (choose one): - Use the parasol against her. (→R1) - Let her go. (→R2)
en.back_flavor:
As Tzu San Niang fires another eldritch beam of crackling light at you, you charge forward, ignoring the pain, and wrest the parasol from her grip. She fights back with all the fury of a cornered animal. Countless souls, all bound in torment to the Key, cry out at once. The woman lets out an ear-piercing scream as the red parasol is wrenched away from her. You step back, brandishing her own weapon.
"A hollow victory," she says haughtily. "I know you don't have the nerve to use my shade against me." She turns to walk away.

vi_current.name: Kẻ Gặt Hái Đau Thương
vi_current.text: Objective — Siêu thoát cho oán linh và tịch thu Chìa Khóa Oan Khuất. [action]: Advance.
vi_current.flavor: Bạn đọc bài kinh cầu siêu trong khi chống đỡ những đòn tấn công cuồng loạn!
vi_current.back_flavor: Nét mặt người phụ nữ dịu lại, chiếc dù đỏ rơi xuống và bà tan biến vào ánh sáng bình minh.

en.name: Otherworldly Horror
en.text: As an additional cost to enter an unrevealed location, investigators at your location must spend 1[per_investigator] clues, as a group. [reaction] After you expose a location: Move to that location (from an adjacent location).
en.flavor: Beyond our reality, in the dimension known only to the forgotten and the forsaken, lies the preposterous City of Remnants - the home world of the Outsiders themselves.
en.back_text:
Shuffle the set-aside Apocalyptic Presage and Protoplasmic Reassembler enemies into the encounter deck.
The investigators must choose two options, as a group:
- Each investigator takes 1 damage and 1 horror.
- Each investigator chooses a non-weakness card they control in their hand or play area and sets it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
- Shuffle all concealed mini-cards facedown, then place them at random in the positions they were in.
en.back_flavor: Whirlwinds of cosmic dust swirl throughout the alien sky, threads of radiant starlight and tempests of gravity-defying rubble shifting, churning, rearranging. Every inch of this place is a deliberate act of insanity, a premeditated manipulation of your mind, designed to make you lose your sense of self.

vi_current.name: Kinh Hoàng Dị Giới
vi_current.text: Như một chi phí bổ sung để tiến vào một địa điểm chưa lật mở, các điều tra viên tại địa điểm của bạn phải tiêu 1[per_investigator] manh mối, dưới dạng một nhóm. [reaction] Sau khi bạn expose một địa điểm: Di chuyển đến địa điểm đó (từ một địa điểm liền kề).
vi_current.flavor: Con tàu của bạn trôi dạt vào Tam Giác Bermuda và bị hút sang một chiều không gian kỳ dị ngoài vũ trụ (The Outside).
vi_current.back_flavor: Không gian đỏ rực như máu với những cấu trúc hình học bẻ cong thực tại.

en.name: Otherworldly Lambs
en.text: As an additional cost to enter an unrevealed location, investigators at your location must spend 1[per_investigator] clues, as a group. [reaction] After you expose a location: Move to that location (from an adjacent location).
en.flavor: The longer you stay in this realm, the more your grip on the world you came from begins to slip. Faces, names, and places all fall through the gaps in your memory. You realize with horror that the power of the Outside goes both ways. Simply being in this realm, even of your own volition, is enough to lose yourself.
en.back_text:
The investigators must choose two options, as a group:
- Each investigator takes 1 damage and 1 horror.
- Each investigator chooses a non-weakness card they control in their hand or play area and sets it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
- Shuffle all concealed mini-cards facedown, then place them at random in the positions they were in.
en.back_flavor: The weight of an infinite, dimensionless universe forces you to your knees. You imagine Taylor's "layer cake," layer upon layer upon layer, worlds upon worlds upon wolrds, and yours is the thinnest of all. You are hurtling through barriers humanity was never meant to cross, and if you remain here any longer, you won't even remember where you came from.

vi_current.name: Những Con Cừu Dị Giới
vi_current.text: Như một chi phí bổ sung để tiến vào một địa điểm chưa lật mở, các điều tra viên tại địa điểm của bạn phải tiêu 1[per_investigator] manh mối, dưới dạng một nhóm. [reaction] Sau khi bạn expose một địa điểm: Di chuyển đến địa điểm đó (từ một địa điểm liền kề).
vi_current.flavor: Lũ sinh vật săn mồi dị giới lùa đoàn thám hiểm vào các lò sát sinh không gian.
vi_current.back_flavor: Tiếng gầm rú của những quái thú ngoài chiều không gian vang dội.

en.name: Otherworldly Slaughter
en.text: As an additional cost to enter an unrevealed location, investigators at your location must spend 1[per_investigator] clues, as a group. [reaction] After you expose a location: Move to that location (from an adjacent location). [fast] Take 1 direct damage or 1 direct horror: Look at the revealed side of a concealed mini-card (without exposing it). (Group limit once per round.)
en.flavor: come you did what do to here ?again
en.back_text:
Each investigator who has not resigned is driven insane, and is never seen or heard from again. All memory of their existence is purged from reality.
If any investigators resigned, those investigators may immediately advance to act 3b.
en.back_flavor: You are nothing; timeless, forgotten, a figment, a shard of a fractured memory; but here, so much more; a promise, a signatory, a blood-inked curse in a covenant of teardrops ever swimming ever falling ever drowning in thoughts in memory in time; and it, it is the final err, it is the final terror that shall reign; and your thoughts, your memories, they are its and it is you; coin-sides, both and all and nothing at once, all at once, all at once.

vi_current.name: Cuộc Tàn Sát Dị Giới
vi_current.text: Như một chi phí bổ sung để tiến vào một địa điểm chưa lật mở, các điều tra viên tại địa điểm của bạn phải tiêu 1[per_investigator] manh mối, dưới dạng một nhóm. [reaction] Sau khi bạn expose một địa điểm: Di chuyển đến địa điểm đó (từ một địa điểm liền kề). [fast] Nhận 1 direct damage hoặc 1 direct horror: Nhìn vào mặt lật ngửa của một lá bài nhỏ concealed (mà không làm lộ diện nó). (Giới hạn nhóm một lần mỗi vòng.)
vi_current.flavor: Cánh cổng trở về Trái Đất sắp vĩnh viễn khép lại!
vi_current.back_text: Mỗi điều tra viên bị bỏ lại vĩnh viễn ở Dị Giới. (→R2)
vi_current.back_flavor: Thực tại của bạn bị xóa sổ khỏi lịch sử nhân loại không để lại dấu vết.

en.name: Traversing the Outside
en.text: Objective - Find the heart of the Outsiders' domain. When the Outsiders' Lair is revealed, advance.
en.flavor: Somewhere in this strange otherworld lies a secret so vital, an ages-old member of the Red Coterie was willing to reach out to you personally to have you help her find this place - the world where all things stolen from memory end up. If the truth is anywhere, it must be here.
en.back_text: Spawn the set-aside Mimetic Nemesis enemy at Outsiders' Lair, exhausted. Each investigator chooses 2 non-weakness cards in their discard pile and sets them aside, out of play, as hollows. Find the set-aside The Red-Gloved Man story asset and place him with the other set-aside hollows, as a hollow. He is considered to be owned by all of the investigators. If he is the bearer of any keys, do not attach those keys to him.
en.back_flavor: As the dark, beating heart of the City of Remnants is a mess of a structure, all black onyx stone and jagged, twisting glass. Hanging throughout the horrid lair is a jumbled nest of chains, fencewire, and alien cables. One of the entities floats in the center of the chamber: a ball of twisted, distorted space with two tendrils of shimmering plasmic light. The tendrils reach down to a humanoid figure in tattered cloth, touching its unconscious mind and pumping something out of it. You step closer and realize with horror that you recognize the covered figure upon the altar - or, at least, you recognize its stark red gloves.

vi_current.name: Băng Qua Dị Giới
vi_current.text: Objective — Thám hiểm các đảo đá trôi nổi giữa không gian và tìm kiếm mỏ neo thời gian.
vi_current.flavor: Mỗi bước nhảy giữa các phiến đá lơ lửng đòi hỏi sự chính xác tuyệt đối.
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn tìm thấy tàn tích của một con tàu thám hiểm từng mất tích năm 1918.

en.name: Red Ruin
en.text: The Red-Gloved Man cannot be discarded or drawn. [action] If Mimetic Nemesis is at your location, spend 1 clue: Deal 2 damage to it. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity from Mimetic Nemesis. Objective - When The Red-Gloved man enters play, advance.
en.flavor: You don't truly know what's going on, but you know it can't be good. You have to stop whatever process is happening here - only then can you learn the truth from the man in the red gloves.
en.back_flavor:
You finally manage to pry the body of the Red-Gloved Man away from the creature's flashing tendrils and drag him off of the altar. He drifts in and out of consciousness as you carry him out of the entity's lair, speaking only nonsense words in an unearthly language. The moment his eyelids open before the alien skies of the Outside, he shudders awake in agony, letting out gasping, pained breaths and clutching the very spot on his forehead where the creature had latched onto him.
You give him a moment to recover before asking him how he got here and what it was doing to him. To his credit, the man does not take long to return to his usual stoic demeanor, adjusting the cuffs of his suit and lowering the brim of his hat to obscure the sweat dripping down his forehead. "Not here," he says. As if on cue, the structure of glass and onyx shudders into ruin and the entity emerges, its tendrils unfolding into a massive, eldritch shape of luminous distortion. "I don't suppose you know a way out of here?" the man asks.

vi_current.name: Phế Tích Đỏ
vi_current.text: Objective — Kích hoạt lại động cơ liên chiều của con tàu đắm.
vi_current.flavor: Cỗ máy cổ phát ra những luồng tia lửa điện xanh tím kỳ bí.
vi_current.back_flavor: Động cơ nổ máy, mở ra một vết nứt dẫn về biển khơi Trái Đất.

en.name: Escaping the Otherworld
en.text: Each [[Outsider]] enemy loses aloof. Forced - If The Red-Gloved Man is defeated: Remove him from the game. Objective - Time to get the hell out of here! If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.
en.flavor: The Red-Gloved Man is on your side and answers are finally within reach. But first you must find a way back home... because if you can't, this might become your new home.
en.back_text: Check which [[Conspirator]] assets are in the victory display. - If both The Red-Gloved Man and Aliki Zoni Uperetria are in the victory display, proceed to (→R1) (page 57). - If The Red-Gloved Man is in the victory display, proceed to (→R2) (page 58). - If Aliki Zoni Uperetria is in the victory display, proceed to (→R3) (page 58). - If neither The Red-Gloved Man nor Aliki Zoni Uperetria are in the victory display, proceed to (→R4) (page 58).
en.back_flavor: You stand at the edge of the platform upon which you arrived in this realm, wondering how to return to your own. There is no sign whatsoever of the ship that fell into the pit below. Perhaps it made its way back. Or perhaps it is still falling. You have no way to know for sure, but very few alternatives. Holding your breath, you look away from the bottomless pit, and take a leap of faith...

vi_current.name: Thoát Khỏi Dị Giới
vi_current.text: Objective — Lái con tàu xuyên qua vết nứt để trở về thực tại. [action]: Advance.
vi_current.flavor: Con tàu lao vút qua vực thẳm đa chiều!
vi_current.back_flavor: Con tàu trồi lên mặt nước phẳng lặng của biển Bermuda dưới ánh mặt trời rực rỡ.

en.name: Conflux of Consequence
en.text: Forced - When this agenda advances, if it is act 2, 3, or 4: Skip the "b" side of this agenda and proceed directly to agenda 2a.
en.flavor: You have come here to find us, but we found you long, long ago. You will be just another set piece in the monument that is our ultimate prayer to the Elder Ones. See our Grand Temple and hear our Call, O Great Ones beyond the beyond!
en.back_text:
If the current act is Secrets and Lies (v. I):
Leylines of paradimensional energy surround you, threatening to tear you apart.
Each enemy shifts each of their attached keys. Immediately resolve an additional enemy phase (then resume the current phase).
If the current act is Secrets and Lies (v. II):
The portal the red-gloved man opened is almost shut! With no time left to prepare, you leap inside just before it closes.
Place 4 doom on agenda 2a. Advance the act.
If the current act is Secrets and Lies (v. III):
Extradimensional entities surround you, threatening to erase your very existence.
Flip 1 [per_investigator] keys from their [[Stable]] side to their [[Unstable]] side. Immediately resolve an additional enemy phase (then resume with the current phase).

vi_current.name: Hội Tụ Của Hậu Quả
vi_current.text: Forced - Khi agenda này advance, nếu đang là act 2, 3, hoặc 4: Bỏ qua mặt "b" của agenda này và chuyển trực tiếp sang agenda 2a.
vi_current.flavor: Tại tổng hành dinh bí mật của Red Coterie, Đại Hội Các Chìa Khóa (Congress of the Keys) bắt đầu. Toàn bộ các Chìa Khóa Đỏ được tập hợp để viết lại số phận thế giới!
vi_current.back_flavor: Bầu trời chuyển sang màu đỏ máu và không gian rung chuyển dữ dội.

en.name: The World Unbidden
en.flavor: So you deign to scale our monument? Our relic to the many worlds we have devoured? Oh yes; yours is not the first. Very well then. Climb to the vertex, if you can, and behold your ruin.
en.back_text:
Flip each decoy over. Shuffle all concealed mini-cards in play, then place them at random in the positions they were in.
Each investigator takes 2 damage and 2 horror but may either (choose one, or neither):
- Shift an [[Unstable]] key they control without flipping it to its [[Stable]] side to cancel all of the damage and horror just dealt to them by the above effect.
- Flip any number of [[Stable]] keys they control to their [[Unstable]] side to cancel that much damage/horror just dealt to them by the above effect.
en.back_flavor: A peal of thunder resounds across dimensions. In the deep recesses of your mind, the building pressure of infinite forgotten worlds crushes your every sense. Your keys, surging with paradimensional energy, rattle and hum in your hands. Without them, you could scarcely withstand the strain of this realm.

vi_current.name: Thế Giới Bất Tuân
vi_current.flavor: Các thành viên Coterie bắt đầu tranh giành quyền kiểm soát tối thượng.
vi_current.back_flavor: Những kẻ phản bội và trung thành tàn sát lẫn nhau trong hỗn loạn.

en.name: Running Red
en.flavor: Hark! You approach your own ruin. Its scarlet robes are the skin of foes long since vanquished. Its embroidery woven with the arteries of Kings long devoured. Its crown forged from the obelisks of once-great civilizations. You are just another meal. You, too, will be forgotten. And in the end only we shall reign.
en.back_text: Each investigator is defeated.
en.back_flavor: This is the forgotten end-that-is-not-an-end; not an erasure but a turning of the moons; the great twist of irony in the cosmic joke that is existence; consciousness and memory and being together at once and at last; and when the great work of the beyond is complete, your thoughts and dreams will be just a drop of water in an endless ocean of sentience; mine but yours and ours together; and this place will be our home, from now until eternity, and you shall never again hope nor despair, for we will be one and the same.

vi_current.name: Dòng Máu Đỏ Rực
vi_current.flavor: Quyền năng tối thượng của các Chìa Khóa chuẩn bị kích nổ!
vi_current.back_text: Thế giới bị tha hóa vĩnh viễn dưới ách thống trị của Coterie. (→R2)
vi_current.back_flavor: Trật tự nhân loại sụp đổ, nhường chỗ cho một kỷ nguyên đen tối vĩnh hằng.

en.name: Secrets and Lies (v. I)
en.text: The Red-Gloved Man gains concealed 1 [per_investigator] and cannot be damaged. Objective - At the end of the round, if each investigator is at the same location as The Red-Gloved Man, they may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
en.flavor: You have to find the man with the red gloves and discover what his plan is, but the remainder of the Red Coterie stands in your way. Don't they realize the true threat here?
en.back_text: Remove each location from the game. (Investigators are not defeated during this process. Other enemies and attachments at those locations are discarded, and concealed mini-cards are set aside.) Put The Knotted Tower, Gravity-Defying Climb, and The Towering Vertex locations into play in a straight vertical line, with The Towering Vertex at the top and The Knotted Tower at the bottom. Take the top 3 locations in the Otherworld deck and place them in the shadows, arranged in a line from left to right. Take the 3 City of Remnants mini-cards, shuffle them facedown, and arrange them around The Knotted Tower as follows: One to its left, one to its right, and one below. Place each investigator at The Knotted Tower and The Red-Gloved Man enemy at the Towering Vertex. Remove the encounter deck and encounter discard pile from the game, replacing them with the second encounter deck.
en.back_flavor: Finally, you spot the man with the red gloves just before he ducks into a shimmering, extradimensional portal. There is no time to lose - it's now or never! You follow swiftly as the portal closes...

vi_current.name: Bí Mật và Dối Trá (v. I)
vi_current.text: Objective — Vạch trần kẻ chủ mưu thực sự đứng sau Hội Coterie.
vi_current.flavor: Những liên minh mong manh bắt đầu rạn nứt.
vi_current.back_flavor: Cuối cùng, bạn cũng bắt gặp người đàn ông đeo găng tay đỏ ngay trước khi ông ta lách mình vào một cánh cổng ngoài chiều không gian đang lấp lánh. Không còn thời gian để chần chừ nữa - bây giờ hoặc không bao giờ! Bạn nhanh chóng lao theo ngay khi cánh cổng khép lại...

en.name: Secrets and Lies (v. II)
en.text: Do not draw cards from the encounter deck during the mythos phase. Objective - Prepare for your journey into the Outside, and proceed when you are ready. At the end of any round, if each investigator is at the same location, they may advance. The sooner, the better. (Hint - You will also be forced to advance automatically when the agenda advances.)
en.flavor: You have one last chance to explore the Red Coterie's hideout before you depart. But time is of the essence!
en.back_text: Remove agenda 1a from the game, moving all of its doom to agenda 2a. Remove each location from the game. (Investigators are not defeated during this process. Other enemies and attachments at those locations are discarded, and concealed mini-cards are set aside.) Put The Knotted Tower, Gravity-Defying Climb, and The Towering Vertex locations into play in a straight vertical line, with The Towering Vertex at the top and The Knotted Tower at the bottom. Take the top 3 locations in the Otherworld deck and place them in the shadows, arranged in a line from left to right. Take the 3 City of Remnants mini-cards and X decoys, where X is the amount of doom on agenda 2a, shuffle them facedown, and distribute them as evenly as possible around The Knotted Tower to its left, right, and below. Place each investigator at The Knotted Tower and The Red-Gloved Man enemy at the Towering Vertex. Shuffle each other set-aside [[Coterie]] enemy into the encounter deck. (Note: From now on, draw cards from the encounter deck during each mythos phase, as normal.)
en.back_flavor: You step through the portal, uncertain if you will ever return...

vi_current.name: Bí Mật và Dối Trá (v. II)
vi_current.text: Objective — Thuyết phục các thành viên ôn hòa đứng về phía bạn.
vi_current.flavor: Dùng lý lẽ và chứng cứ để vạch mặt kẻ phản bội.
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn bước qua cánh cổng, không chắc liệu mình có bao giờ quay trở lại được hay không...

en.name: Secrets and Lies (v. III)
en.text: The Red-Gloved Man gains concealed 1 [per_investigator] and cannot be damaged. Objective - At the end of the round, if each investigator is at the same location as The Red-Gloved Man, they may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
en.flavor: Outsiders have attacked the Red Coterie's hideout! Only one among them has the answers you seek. You must find the "Red-Gloved Man" - or the entity that wears his face - and follow it back to the world whence it came.
en.back_text: Remove each location from the game. (Investigators are not defeated during this process. Other enemies and attachments at those locations are discarded, and concealed mini-cards are set aside.) Put The Knotted Tower, Gravity-Defying Climb, and The Towering Vertex locations into play in a straight vertical line, with The Towering Vertex at the top and The Knotted Tower at the bottom. Take the top 3 locations in the Otherworld deck and place them in the shadows, arranged in a line from left to right. Take the 3 City of Remnants mini-cards, shuffle them facedown, and arrange them around The Knotted Tower as follows: One to its left, one to its right, and one below. Place each investigator at The Knotted Tower and The Red-Gloved Man enemy at the Towering Vertex.
en.back_flavor: Finally, you spot the man with the red gloves just before he ducks into a shimmering, extradimensional portal. There is no time to lose - it's now or never! You follow swiftly as the portal closes...

vi_current.name: Bí Mật và Dối Trá (v. III)
vi_current.text: Objective — Đột kích phòng điều khiển trung tâm.
vi_current.flavor: Những khẩu súng máy khai hỏa chặn bước chân bạn.
vi_current.back_flavor: Cuối cùng, bạn cũng bắt gặp người đàn ông đeo găng tay đỏ ngay trước khi ông ta lách mình vào một cánh cổng ngoài chiều không gian đang lấp lánh. Không còn thời gian để chần chừ nữa - bây giờ hoặc không bao giờ! Bạn nhanh chóng lao theo ngay khi cánh cổng khép lại...

en.name: To the Tower
en.text: Locations and concealed mini-cards cannot be placed adjacent to [[Tower]] locations. Objective - Find a way into the tower where the infiltrator lies in wait. If an investigator enters the Gravity-Defying Climb, advance.
en.flavor: Beyond all of known reality, in the dimension known only to the forgotten and the forsaken, lies the preposterous City of Remnants - the home world of the Outsiders themselves. Looming before you, a terrifying, twisted tower of jumbled architecture is a nexus of roiling mist and clouds across an alien sky.
en.back_text:
Set each concealed mini-card aside, out of play. Remove each City of Remnants in the shadows and the remainder of the Otherworld deck from the game.
Take the 3 City of Remnants concealed mini-cards and 1 [per_investigator] decoys, shuffle them facedown, and arrange them around Gravity-Defying Climb in a random order.
en.back_flavor: Seven forgotten locks grant entry to the tower, each one a piece of history from a realm long since erased from time. You forget they exist the moment the gates open. On the other side, steps course their way up the spire's baffling length. Winding, perplexing, and seemingly infinite, the ascent to the apex of the tower that binds this world together is paradoxical, a Gordian knot twisted far too many times. Even if you make it to the top, you doubt you will ever find a way back.

vi_current.name: Tiến Lên Tháp Cao
vi_current.text: Objective — Mở đường máu vượt qua các tầng tháp để lên phòng nghi lễ đỉnh tháp.
vi_current.flavor: Bạn leo lên đỉnh tháp nơi vòng tròn các Chìa Khóa đang phát sáng cực độ.
vi_current.back_flavor: Bạn bước vào sảnh nghi lễ tối thượng đối mặt với kẻ thù cuối cùng!

en.name: The Ascent
en.text: Objective - Ascend. If an investigator enters The Towering Vertex, advance.
en.flavor:
A terrible feeling of vertigo washes over you as you begin to scale the cyclopean, Escheresque steps.
Only one way to go now.
en.back_text:
Set each concealed mini-card aside, out of play.
Swap the set-aside Mimetic Nemesis enemy with The Red-Gloved Man enemy at The Towering Vertex.
Take the Mimetic Nemesis's mini-card and 2 [per_investigator] decoys, shuffle them facedown, and arrange them around The Towering Vertex in a random order.
en.back_flavor: With herculean effort, you practically crawl from the final step to the tower's pinnacle. Twisting clouds of crimson and violet clash in a multidimensional sky, infinite gateways to infinite worlds, all of them oblivious, all of them blind, all of them theirs for the taking. You look out upon the world of the Outsiders with both awe and pity, upon the countless worlds' worth of ruin they have collected, discarded, forsaken, lost to all time. It is a garbage heap of cosmic proportions. At the very center lies your foe who has orchestrated humanity's erasure. Its body only scarcely resembles that of the Red-Gloved Man now. With no human face to wear, its gaze is empty, its expression unknowable.

vi_current.name: Cuộc Vươn Lên
vi_current.text: Objective — Đánh bại kẻ nắm giữ Chìa Khóa Tối Thượng.
vi_current.flavor: Trận quyết chiến định đoạt tương lai của loài người!
vi_current.back_flavor: Kẻ chủ mưu bị tước vũ khí, chiếc Chìa Khóa rơi xuống tâm vòng tròn ma thuật.

en.name: The Final Err
en.text: [action] Flip a [[Stable]] key you control to its [[Unstable]] side: Remove an exposed decoy from the game. Objective - If Mimetic Nemesis is defeated, advance.
en.flavor: You brandish the keys you have collected and brace yourself. If you cannot expel this entity and collapse this dimension, it will be the end of you all - and none will ever be the wiser. This is it. Your last chance before there is nothing of you left. nothing of you left nothing
en.back_flavor:
The entity collapses upon itself, its wordless screech washing over the world and worlds beyond, reverberating through your skull, tearing you apart molecule by molecule. You remain tethered to reality only by the energy of your keys, which endure even as all else implodes around you. There is a sensation of tugging at the back of your skull, a feeling of being yanked by a fishhook out of ravaged waters.
Then, darkness.

vi_current.name: Sai Lầm Cuối Cùng
vi_current.text: Objective — Thu hồi toàn bộ các Chìa Khóa và phong ấn vĩnh viễn quyền năng của chúng. [action]: Advance.
vi_current.flavor: Hãy đưa ra quyết định cuối cùng cho số phận của các Chìa Khóa Đỏ!
vi_current.back_flavor: Các Chìa Khóa Đỏ được phong ấn an toàn. Mạng lưới gián điệp Coterie tan rã và hòa bình trở lại với thế giới!
